title: Skipass Madness After Christmas
summary: 2.5D downhill skiing with real slope physics on six Roccaraso pistes, against the holiday crowd and the clock.
description: An original third-person downhill skiing game on six real-inspired pistes of the Roccaraso / Alto Sangro ski area in Abruzzo (E1 Aremogna, M1 Monte Pratello, D4 Toppe-Aremogna, D1 Toppe del Tesoro, T8 Pizzalto, K2 Crete Rosse) with real start and finish altitudes. A drone-follow 2.5D camera renders the altitude profile in depth slices, so crests hide the slope beyond, steep pitches reveal the valley and the camera pitches with the mountain. Fixed-point physics simulates gravity along the slope, snow friction (groomed, ice, powder, moguls, snowplough, skidding), aerodynamic drag in upright and tuck, carving radius, ballistic jumps and landings. Dodge the after-Christmas crowd, ski schools, sitting snowboarders and snowcats, pass under chairlifts and past the rifugi, and reach the valley before the skipass expires. Networked consoles in the same room race as live rivals with ranking. Stereo SID-like music only on title, demo, winning and game-over screens; skiing uses stereo procedural effects (snow hiss, wind, carving scrape, landings, crashes, checkpoints).
controls: Left/Right carve; Up tuck; Down snowplough/brake; B pole push (title: MAESTRO assist on/off); A/Start select and start
